answer: The island schedule is applied in pearl and relic makes public each instalment. Someone therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 47% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2279 identities would post 4354 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
